verdict.rationale: Docs show clear support for custom events/fields, custom metadata, session IDs for anonymous users, historical backfill, and JS/SDK/REST ingestion of behavioral and device-level signals feeding the risk score and workflows — directly matching the developer story of feeding custom signals into scoring. A live probe confirms the Events API is real and functioning as documented. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on evidence specifically validating custom fields' effect on score weighting, and no explicit device-fingerprint API example beyond general SDK mentions.
